economics.includes_contractors_note: Headcount includes the working owner and recurring contractors as people, not FTE equivalents. Contractors may be part-time. Scaled scenario adds one employee and one contractor; external vendor workforces are not counted as internal team members.

economics.cost_basis: Annual net margins include operating expenses and non-owner labor; monthly opex is fixed/semi-fixed overhead only. No owner salary is deducted. Capital needs may grow beyond startup range.

plays.name: Certificate-of-Need (CON) & Decommissioned Hospital Imaging-Suite Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Acquire or option decommissioned imaging assets where approved site capacity has value, separating equipment resale economics from nontransferable or change-of-control-sensitive CON authority.
inputs: State CON decisions and hospital closure notices
Equipment service logs and site engineering surveys
Regulatory transfer guidance and buyer commitments
workflow: 1. Identify closing imaging suites and inventory equipment, permits, and lease rights
2. Confirm CON status, transfer restrictions, radiation licensing, and deinstallation costs
3. Negotiate approval-contingent asset purchases with qualified operators and equipment buyers
4. Close after regulatory clearance and document certified removal, installation, and acceptance

platform_risks.failure_mode: CON authority lapses or cannot transfer
platform_risks.trigger: Closure, relocation, or ownership change outside approved conditions
platform_risks.impact: Loss of site premium and stranded equipment carrying costs
platform_risks.detection_metric: Outstanding regulatory conditions and days to permit expiry
platform_risks.fallback: Exit under approval contingencies or sell inspected equipment separately without representing transferable operating authority

plays.name: Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Schedule E/F Trade-Claim & Convenience-Class Rollups
plays.mechanism: Purchase documented small trade claims below risk-adjusted expected plan distributions, accounting for objections, assignment procedures, and plan rules that may prohibit claim splitting or aggregation benefits.
inputs: Bankruptcy schedules E/F and claims register
Invoices, payment history, and assignment documents
Proposed plan classification and distribution waterfall
workflow: 1. Reconcile scheduled trade creditors with filed claims and supporting invoices
2. Model recoveries under plan amendments, objections, setoffs, and convenience-class eligibility
3. Buy eligible claims through documented assignments and complete required transfer notices
4. Monitor objections and confirmation, then reconcile distributions to each acquired claim
metrics: Allowed claim value versus purchased face value
Realized return and days to distribution

platform_risks.trigger: Disputed invoices, setoff rights, or plan restrictions on purchased or split claims
platform_risks.impact: Reduced distribution or complete capital loss
platform_risks.detection_metric: Objection rate and eligible allowed value per portfolio
platform_risks.fallback: Stop affected purchases, enforce documented seller recourse where available, and price only supported general-unsecured recoveries

plays.name: MCA UCC-1 Trigger Stacking & Dual-Sided Default-Restructure Brokerage
plays.mechanism: Use UCC filing changes to identify businesses that may need cash-flow review and consensual MCA restructuring, with verified obligations and disclosed compensation rather than encouraging undisclosed stacking.
inputs: Public UCC filings and termination records
Broker licensing rules and disclosed creditor compensation terms
workflow: 1. Treat UCC changes as outreach signals, not proof of default, and obtain merchant authorization
2. Reconcile advances, liens, repayment pulls, covenants, and sustainable payment capacity
3. Disclose dual-sided fees and conflicts; use independent counsel where representation would conflict
4. Coordinate documented creditor-approved modifications and monitor actual payment relief
metrics: Net merchant payment relief after fees

platform_risks.failure_mode: Conflicted brokerage or prohibited stacking worsens default
platform_risks.trigger: Hidden commissions, inaccurate balances, or new financing breaching existing contracts
platform_risks.detection_metric: Undisclosed fee exceptions and covenant breaches per engagement
platform_risks.fallback: Stop placement, refund improper fees, and refer the merchant to independent licensed restructuring counsel
